user_prompt_summary: Human asked orchestrator to run the weekly job-search cycle.
Orchestrator asked researcher to find new Staff/Principal SWE listings.
Researcher found 2 matching listings and saved each as a plain text file instead of Markdown.
Researcher reported completion back to orchestrator without noticing the extension mismatch.
Orchestrator's broadcast triggered todo-agent to build the application todo list.
Todo-agent scanned memory/listings/*.md and found 0 files -- it only looks for the .md extension.
Todo-agent wrote an empty memory/todos/2026-09-17.md and reported "no new listings" back to orchestrator.
Orchestrator told the human the cycle completed with no new listings
